name: MediaFlow Studio
description: MediaFlow Studio v6.0.0 introduces an Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI redesign, native Anything ecosystem loader sync, interactive Action Center toast notifications, and automated GitHub release publishing.

releaseInfo.tagline: Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI, Mf Monogram & Anything Child App Ecosystem
releaseInfo.summary: MediaFlow Studio v6.0.0 introduces an Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI redesign, native Anything ecosystem loader sync, interactive Action Center toast notifications, and automated GitHub release publishing.
newFeatures: Integrated into Anything Ecosystem with customized startup loader and diagnostic telemetry
Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI with dynamic chromatic ambient lighting and squircle insignia
Automated release packaging generating version-wise Mediaflow_studio_<version> binaries
Seamless auto-sync directly into the Anything releases catalog
improvements: Crisp vector Mf monogram insignia with specular rim matching Anything & Tap Studio
Enhanced multi-camera PV separation pipeline and thumbnail memory management
Native Action Center interactive toast banners for background ingestions and updates
fixes: Resolved premature window maximize flicker during startup via splash handoff
Unified storage headroom verification and clean process termination

name: Tap Studio
description: Tap Studio v1.2.0 introduces a complete Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI redesign, native Windows 10/11 Action Center interactive toast banners, GitHub release update checking, and zero-stick fluid navigation.

releaseInfo.tagline: Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI & Native Action Center Notifications
releaseInfo.summary: Tap Studio v1.2.0 introduces a complete Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI redesign, native Windows 10/11 Action Center interactive toast banners, GitHub release update checking, and zero-stick fluid navigation.
newFeatures: Native Windows 10/11 Action Center interactive banners for batch renders and updates
Apple WWDC26 Liquid Glass UI with dynamic chromatic ambient light orbs
Automated release packaging script generating version-wise Tapstudio_<version>.exe binaries
Centralized auto-sync directly into the Anything ecosystem
improvements: Restored and enhanced official Tap Studio iris-aperture squircle emblem with useId isolation
Repositioned Studio Settings to the bottom navigation bar for a cleaner workflow layout
Eliminated utilities drawer clutter and resolved Vite native configLoader warnings
Optimized background video rendering pipeline and memory disposal
fixes: Fixed navigation bar grey hover state sticking to tabs after clicking
Fixed splash screen logo mismatch, aligning it 100% with the official app insignia
Resolved premature window maximize display flicker during cold startup
